observations: Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub PRO C754e' are clearly printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine has a touchscreen control panel and four paper trays.
The top glass surface is covered with plastic wrap.
The machine is located in an outdoor or semi-outdoor environment with other printers visible in the background.
A watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' is present on the image.

claims.claim: large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a large machine with a touchscreen and paper trays

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The internal toner and drum may be empty or degraded despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum status screen or a printed page showing remaining capacity.
risks.if_unproven: as needing new toner and drum

risks.risk: The paper trays may be damaged or unable to hold paper.
risks.proof: A video showing paper being loaded and ejected from the trays.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner and drum status screen.
Video showing paper being loaded and ejected from the trays.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photo, so it can be priced at its worst case as seen, even though the seller's functional claims are unverified.
